stem.text: Ammonia can undergo an acid–base reaction with hydrogen chloride to form ammonium chloride.

B.text: The hydrogen atom from $\text{HCl}$ donates a lone pair of electrons to the nitrogen atom.

C.text: The $\text{H–N–H}$ bond angle in ammonia is the same as the $\text{H–N–H}$ bond angle in the ammonium ion.

D.text: The $\text{H–N–H}$ bond angle in the ammonium ion is the same as the $\text{H–C–H}$ bond angle in methane.
